6792.title: Workflow native-default selection is rejected
6792.rootCauseOneLine: Both Workflows validators require list membership even for known-empty reasoning catalogs, rejecting native defaults and inherited preferences before spawn.
6792.proposedFix: Share selection policy, accept the catalog default for known-empty models, normalize inherited preferences before cache identity and worker creation, and retain rejection for unresolved discovery and unsupported explicit efforts.
6792.caveats: Verified twice from clean main checkouts at the validation/service boundary; no live model backend was exercised. Reproduction code and logs are inline per reports repository policy.
